verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships an official CLI (omarchy-cli) with utility commands like omarchy-snapshot and fip that power-users can invoke/script, and the docs emphasize keyboard-driven, terminal-first workflows. However, there is no dedicated automation/scripting framework (e.g., task runner, hooks, cron-like scheduler) documented — the CLI commands are discrete utilities rather than a general automation tool. Missing for 10: a documented scripting/automation framework or hook system, independent evidence of power-users automating repetitive tasks with it.
